Class TabbedListParameterRenderer

java.lang.Object
uno.anahata.asi.swing.agi.message.part.tool.param.AbstractParameterRenderer<List<Object>>
uno.anahata.asi.swing.agi.message.part.tool.param.AbstractListParameterRenderer<Object>
uno.anahata.asi.swing.agi.message.part.tool.param.TabbedListParameterRenderer
All Implemented Interfaces:
ParameterRenderer<List<Object>>
public class TabbedListParameterRenderer extends AbstractListParameterRenderer<Object>
A generic composite parameter renderer that arranges a list of items into an AdjustingTabPane.

For each item in the list, a child ParameterRenderer is instantiated and registered with ParameterRenderer.setParentRenderer(ParameterRenderer). Tab titles are derived from Displayable.getDisplayValue() if implemented, or an indexed fallback.

Hierarchical Child-to-Parent Propagation: When any child renderer notifies AbstractListParameterRenderer.childValueChanged(ParameterRenderer, Object), this compositor updates the corresponding item in the list and invokes AbstractParameterRenderer.valueChanged(Object), propagating the updated collection to the parent renderer or directly to the tool call's modified arguments.
